curriculum.title: Six stages to speaking English.
curriculum.subtitle: A single path from foundations to real communication.

s1.title: Stage 1 — Foundations
s1.objective: Understand the shape of English and build simple sentences.

s2.title: Stage 2 — Sentence building
s2.objective: Express what you want to say clearly and accurately.

s3.title: Stage 3 — Real-life English
s3.objective: Handle travel, shopping and everyday conversation.

s4.title: Stage 4 — Listening & pronunciation
s4.objective: Catch natural English and respond intelligibly.

s5.title: Stage 5 — English at work
s5.objective: Handle email, meetings and calls in English.

s6.title: Stage 6 — Consolidation
s6.objective: Integrate everything and make English your own.

beginner.a: Yes. Stage 1 starts from foundations, so it works for anyone restarting from school-level English.

mobile.q: Can I take the course on a smartphone?
mobile.a: Yes. The platform works on phone, tablet and PC.

expiry.a: There is no expiry at this time. See the terms of service for details.

download.a: To protect copyright, videos are streaming-only and cannot be downloaded.

password.q: What if I forget my password?
password.a: Use "Forgot your password?" on the login screen to reset via your registered email.

start.q: When can I start after paying?
start.a: As soon as your payment is confirmed, all content is unlocked.

receipt.a: Yes. You can download a receipt from your account page.

support.a: Yes. Japanese-language customer support is available.
